description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers related to authentication processes including signup, login, retrieving current user info, and logout. It uses SQLAlchemy for database interactions and includes security functions such as password hashing and token creation.

classes.name: User
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing a user entity, including fields like email, password hash, role, full name, and activity status.

methods.name: UserResponse signup(payload: SignUpRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new User record after validating that the email isn't already registered.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token if the credentials are valid.

methods.name: UserResponse me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: APIMessage logout()
methods.description: Provides a stateless logout indication; client should discard the token.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(payload: SignUpRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserResponse:$/
